map.均分用向下取整，因此 Σ单页秒数 ≤ 总时长，余数（最多 页数−1 秒）被舍去，: Even splitting uses floor, so Σ seconds per slide <= total time and the remainder (up to slides-1 seconds) is dropped; negligible for long talks but noticeably tight for short sessions (e.g. 1 minute for 10 slides), so add the remainder back manually.
